Cumulative GHG emission reductions from replacement of baseline spray foam blowing agent with low/lower GWP alternative (tCO2 eq per year)
Number of training centers provided with training equipment to support service technician training
Cumulative GHG emission reductions from replacement of baseline refrigerants with low/lower GWP alternative in commerical refrigeration sector (tCO2eq per year)

Verification Reports on Annual HCFC Consumption
Beneficiaries reporting satisfaction with key aspects of the Ozone Day public awareness activities
Cumulative number of enterprised covered by the signed sub-grant agreements
Regulation and/or standard supporting HCFC phase-out in spray-foam sub-sector
Licensing and Customs system for tracking HFCs put in place
Mechanism in place to collect data on the number of female service technicians trained by the project
Timely issuance and enforcement of annual HCFC import quotas
